definitions.gloss: solo trip; traveling alone; solo travel
definitions.explanation: A trip taken by oneself without companions. Can refer to both short day trips and longer journeys. Often carries a positive connotation of freedom and self-discovery.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めての{一人旅|ひとりたび}は{京都|きょうと}だった。
examples.english: My first solo trip was to Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {一人旅|ひとりたび}なら{自分|じぶん}のペースで{動|うご}ける。
examples.english: If you travel alone, you can move at your own pace.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}した{記念|きねん}に、ヨーロッパへの{一人旅|ひとりたび}を{計画|けいかく}している。
examples.english: I'm planning a solo trip to Europe to celebrate graduating from university.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {一人|ひとり} (alone) and {旅|たび} (trip/travel). Functions as a する verb ({一人旅|ひとりたび}する — to travel solo). Solo travel has become increasingly popular and accepted in Japan, with many travel magazines and websites dedicated to {一人旅|ひとりたび} recommendations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一人旅|ひとりたび}をする (to take a solo trip)
- {一人旅|ひとりたび}に{出|で}る (to set out on a solo trip)
- {初|はじ}めての{一人旅|ひとりたび} (one's first solo trip)
- {気|き}ままな{一人旅|ひとりたび} (a carefree solo trip)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旅|たび}: trip, travel — the general word, not specifying number of travelers
